response.overview: Searching for his path upon moving home, Khaled (grandson and director) spends time with Mouchira ‘Tetto’ (grandmother). Through documentary footage and theatrically staged segments of Tetto’s storytelling, two things occur in this shared experience between grandmother and grandson; Khaled finds his path through creating the space for his grandmother to explore her unfulfilled dreams of stardom.
response.tagline: An experimental documentary where grandmother and grandson go on a shared journey of personal growth and self actualisation
response.title: En Haut En Bas
